description: (Na)₂NaSbI₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a NaSbI₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaSbI₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form NaI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SbI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-I bond lengths are 3.10 Å. Sb is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form SbI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sb-I bond lengths are 3.01 Å. I is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Sb atom.
